classification: TEST SEMANTICS LIMITATION — prior intrinsic-width overflow boolean is not by itself actual clipping proof
claim: Material3 String Text uses BasicText with no callback/selection/autosize in PostGame. BasicText takes TextStringSimpleElement path. GetTextLayoutResult rebuilds MultiParagraph at parent max dimensions, but retains actual intrinsic text layoutSize. TextLayoutResult compares actual size width against regenerated paragraph width; intrinsic-width text can therefore produce hasVisualOverflow although its glyphs fit. Actual draw uses original Paragraph and layoutCache.didOverflow instead.

current_remediation: Already-frozen full-width Column gives both names and roles full available width, solving original sibling starvation. Tests keep all original positive-width/display/viewport assertions, plus stronger no-overflow check on now-full-width Texts and detailed diagnostics.
